question: After catalog failures are contained, should exact, already-active workspace-directory plugins become an officially supported native Codex plugin source?
rationale: This expands the curated-only organization-plugin trust boundary established by merged history and can expose workspace-owned apps and tools to governed Codex turns.

options.title: Approve narrow fail-closed support
options.body: Admit only exact configured active workspace plugins while keeping lookup failures plugin-local, preserving default-deny app policy, and never installing them from OpenClaw.

options.title: Keep curated-only support
options.body: Retain the current marketplace boundary and decline the workspace-directory feature direction.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow fail-closed support
recommendation.body: Admit only exact configured active workspace plugins while keeping lookup failures plugin-local, preserving default-deny app policy, and never installing them from OpenClaw.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged revert that established the current curated-only marketplace boundary.
